about.title: A Costa Rican company dedicated to your technology
story: TechWave IT Services was founded with a clear purpose: to help Costa Rican businesses adopt and manage their technology. We believe technology should enable the business, not be a headache.

We specialize in four areas: technology, infrastructure, consulting and cybersecurity. This focus allows us to deliver end-to-end solutions with the closeness of a local partner and the standards of the world's leading vendors.

about.vision: To be the go-to strategic technology partner for businesses in Costa Rica, recognized for the quality of our service and the strength of our solutions.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: At TechWave IT Services we respect your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect through this site, what we use it for and what your rights are, in accordance with Costa Rica's Law No. 8968 on the Protection of Individuals Regarding the Processing of Their Personal Data.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: TechWave IT Services, located in San José, Costa Rica. Contact email: info@techwaveitservices.com.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: Only the data you voluntarily provide in the contact form: first name, last name, email, phone (optional), service of interest and message. We also collect anonymous, aggregated visit statistics, without cookies and without identifying individuals.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: We use your data exclusively to answer your inquiry, prepare quotes and follow up commercially on our services. We do not sell or transfer your data to third parties for commercial purposes.

sections.title: Storage and security
sections.body: Form messages are stored in Zoho Forms, a provider that applies technical and administrative security measures. We keep your data only as long as necessary for the stated purpose.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, cancellation and objection at any time by writing to info@techwaveitservices.com. We will respond within the time limits set by law.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy. The current version will always be published on this page with its update date.
